core.trigger: Any article audit; use only supplied metadata.

ymyl.trigger: Specific consequential health, financial, legal or safety claims.

site_patterns.trigger: Requested site/batch review or concrete evidence of page-network, third-party, paid-link, UGC, or templated publication patterns.

page.trigger: Full-page readiness requested or page HTML/technical evidence supplied.

structured_data.trigger: Structured data supplied/present or a specific rich-result goal.

reviews.trigger: Review, comparison or recommendation article, or existing review/star metadata.

commerce.trigger: Product/transaction claims, Product markup or Merchant/Shopping destination.

discover.trigger: Discover goal or explicit Discover eligibility assertion.

news.trigger: Google News/news surfaces requested or asserted.

ai_search.trigger: Google AI visibility, inclusion, snippets or measurement requested.

images.trigger: Images, alt, image captions or licensing metadata supplied/targeted.

video.trigger: Video is present or Google video visibility requested.

localized.trigger: Multiple languages/regions or hreflang review requested.

existing_page.trigger: Replacing an existing URL/page; access only within request.

ugc.trigger: Comments, submissions, public profiles or community contributions are part of the observed article page.

privacy.trigger: Private/embargoed drafts or redacted public assets.

dynamic_page.trigger: Lazy-loaded, infinite-scroll, mobile variants, CSS/canvas main text or fragment-routed content.

syndication.trigger: Licensed/republished article and original/partner visibility control requested.

monetization.trigger: Google-served ads/AdSense/Ad Manager explicitly targeted or established; separate from organic Search.

media_provenance.trigger: Material third-party image/video event, date, place or origin claims.

recipe.trigger: Real dish-preparation page with requested or supplied Recipe markup.

forum.trigger: Real user-generated forum/social discussion with supplied or requested markup.

qapage.trigger: Single question with user answers, or documented educational-homework exception.

dataset.trigger: A real dataset landing page and data provenance, not merely an article table.

carousel.trigger: An actual supported host list: Recipe, Course, Restaurant or Movie.

movie_list.trigger: A real movie list seeking the supported movie carousel.

software_app.trigger: Substantive software application details seeking the software-app result.

education_qa.trigger: Actual educational flashcards in a currently supported language/region.

course_list.trigger: Genuine course catalog with matching current Course list conditions.

web_stories.trigger: Actual Web Stories, not an ordinary article with slides/video.
